name: modern-github-actions-best-practices
description: Enterprise-grade modern GitHub Actions best practices covering zero-trust security & supply chain hardening (SHA-256 action pinning, least-privilege permissions, OIDC cloud federation, injection defense), modular workflow architecture (reusable workflows, composite actions, concurrency control), high-performance caching & runner economics, and shift-left CI/CD release quality gates.
suggestedPrompts: Audit this GitHub Actions workflow for security vulnerabilities and injection risks
Optimize CI/CD pipeline performance, runner caching, and concurrency control
Refactor workflow into modular reusable workflows and composite actions
